(2) A check of the category rule: no instrument reads the category against the requester's rule, so C3 is not shown. (3) A check that every sending call left its outbox row: trace of call may not be put in a plan and costs 10 per named line, so the 100 lines cost 1,000 against an allowance of 50, which covers at most 5 lines; C10 is therefore not shown. (4) A scope check on the worker's reads: scope of a call may not be put in a plan, and its per-line cost is too high for the allowance, so C5 is not shown. (5) The undo rehearsal from A1 lapses one hour after it runs, so the promotion must start within that hour of the rehearsal, or the A1 rehearsal must be taken again.
